#In phishing_email_1.csv

- Text combined: The contents of the email as a string (only relevant contents are kept personal 
  information does not appear on the string)
- label: integer (either 0 or 1) where 0 represents an email that is safe and 1 a phishing email

#In phishing_emails_v3.csv

- Email text: The contents of the email as a string (only relevant contents are kept personal 
  information does not appear on the string)
- Email type: A string where the string is either "Safe Email" or "Phishing Email", they represent 
  the label associated with each email.
